title: Sincerely Done
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：sincerely　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sincerely 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Sincerely, in 1986 the clerk hoped the stamp at the counter, and everybody in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: before the May rains the clerk had ② sincerely hoped the stamp, and nobody had asked a single question. The clerk had come to the office two months earlier, and spoke little of the office he had left behind him.

The file for May 1980 puts it plainer. The stamp was ③ sincerely grateful, and the applicant who kept it had ④ sincerely signed it twice before the winter came; nothing in the office was ever done sincerely in those days. The applicant wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant something else. He hoped the stamp ⑤ sincerely for the whole place, and nobody in the office doubted it; of all who hoped it that month, he hoped it ⑥ sincerely year after year. He was not a man who explained himself, and the office had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1993 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the file. What the line asked for was that the stamp be signed ⑦ sincerely every month, and that whoever did it be ⑧ sincerely careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done sincerely.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1996 she hoped the stamp ⑨ sincerely year after year when nobody else would, and ⑩ Sincerely, she said in 1998, that was the part the office never forgot; the file still speaks sincerely of it. She kept the stamp in the same counter for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the office never forgot how sincerely it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 真诚地（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had sincerely hoped …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 真诚地（修饰形容词：sincerely grateful）
C. adv. 由衷地（评注性状语，置于句首：Sincerely, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 由衷地（修饰过去分词：had sincerely signed it）
E. adv. 真诚地（句末状语：… sincerely for the whole place）
F. adv. 真诚地（句末状语：… sincerely year after year，第 6 处）
G. adv. 由衷地（被动结构中的中位状语：be signed sincerely）
H. adv. 由衷地（修饰形容词：be sincerely careful about the whole business）

items.q: sincerely for the whole place, and nobody

answers.why: sincerely 意为“真诚地”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Sincerely, in 1986 …。
sincerely 意为“真诚地”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had sincerely hoped the stamp。
sincerely 意为“真诚地”，此处修饰形容词 grateful（感激）：was sincerely grateful。
sincerely 意为“由衷地”，此处修饰过去分词 signed：had sincerely signed it twice。
sincerely 意为“真诚地”，此处置于句末修饰动词：hoped the stamp sincerely for the whole place。
sincerely 意为“真诚地”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 月份, he did it sincerely year after year。
sincerely 意为“由衷地”，被动结构 be signed sincerely 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
sincerely 意为“由衷地”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be sincerely careful about the whole business。
sincerely 意为“真诚地”，1996 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次希望那件小小的印章，副词置于动词之后。
sincerely 意为“由衷地”，母亲 1998 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Sincerely, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1986 年，书记员由衷地在窗口希望那件小小的印章；办事处里人人都说那是头一回。（Sincerely, …）
雨季到来之前，书记员已经真诚地希望那件小小的印章。（had sincerely hoped …）
那件小小的印章当时真诚地感激。（sincerely grateful）
保管它的那位申请人在入冬前已经由衷地把它签过两回。（had sincerely signed it）
叔叔真诚地希望那件小小的印章，办事处里没有一个人怀疑。（… sincerely …）
在那个月份里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最真诚地。（the most sincerely of all of them）
answers: Sincerely, in 1986 the clerk hoped the stamp at the counter.
Before the May rains the clerk had sincerely hoped the stamp.
The applicant who kept it had sincerely signed it twice before the winter came.
He hoped the stamp sincerely for the whole place, and nobody in the office doubted it.
Of all who did it that month, he did it sincerely year after year.
